_comment: Canonical source for agentmux's REQ-047/REQ-050 retention-loop hooks (PreCompact save-transcript, SessionStart goals prose), one block per harness. This file documents what each harness's live hook config should contain; `agentmux hooks install --harness <name>` writes the matching entries into that harness's own config file (~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.grok/hooks/agentmux-hooks.json) rather than reading this file directly. Regenerate this comment block by re-running `agentmux save-transcript --print-hooks --harness <name>` for each harness below after a hook-shape change, and `chezmoi re-add ~/.agents` to sync.

grok._note: Grok Build also scans ~/.claude/settings.json globally ([compat.claude] hooks = true, verified in ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/10-hooks.md), so the claude-code block above fires in Grok too, tagged --harness claude-code. This dedicated file tags Grok-originated captures correctly as --harness grok.
